newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Israel's Netanyahu to visit Russia March 10-12.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu to visit Russia March 10-12.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is expected to visit Russia from March 10 to 12 and will meet President Boris Yeltsin, Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky told Interfax news agency on Friday.
Russia is trying to revive its influence in the Middle East peace process, which it co-sponsors with the United States. Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat was in Moscow this month.
